diagnosis: The sensor readings endpoint queries the local node:sqlite database using the route parameter sensorId without verifying that the sensor belongs to the authenticated user's assigned industrial facility. Any authenticated facility operator can query sensor data from remote chemical processing units, nuclear storage chillers, or proprietary manufacturing lines located in other facilities.
